firm_data.firm_description: Sperber Kahan Law Group PLLC is a full service firm focusing on New York Real Estate litigation & transactional law. With a wealth of experience in real estate litigation and transactions, SK lawyers have consistently achieved favorable legal results and resolutions for our clients in an efficient and effective manner.
notable_facts: Established by Steven B. Sperber and Eric H. Kahan.
Represents owner/landlords, contractors, developers, non-for-profit corporations, educational institutions and/or sponsors.
Handles matters in Civil Courts, State Supreme Court, Federal Courts, as well as the Appellate Terms and Appellate Divisions.

email.subject: AI for Sperber Kahan Law Group - built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Steven,

You and Eric built Sperber Kahan to handle complex real estate litigation and transactions efficiently, and that focus on precision for owner/landlords, developers, and institutions is exactly what caught my attention.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in New York to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your office to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
